findings.title: CHANGELOG.md missing 2026-07-08 nightly audit entry — 10 findings fixed with no record
findings.detail: The 2026-07-08 nightly audit commit (801e35a) fixed 10 findings across spec files — including CRITICAL AGENTS.md/README.md/INTEGRATIONS.md findings and multiple IMPORTANT/COSMETIC items from the 2026-07-08 scan — but no corresponding CHANGELOG entry was added. AGENTS.md §5 requires CHANGELOG.md [Unreleased] to be updated on every spec change. Any agent auditing the CHANGELOG for the current state of the spec will see a 4-day blind spot.
findings.fix_sketch: Prepend a '2026-07-08 — Nightly audit fixes (10 findings fixed — 3 CRITICAL, 5 IMPORTANT, 2 COSMETIC)' entry to [Unreleased] > Changed listing the closed finding IDs.

findings.title: ARCHITECTURE.md frontmatter last_updated (2026-05-26) mismatches footer Last updated (2026-07-04)
findings.detail: ARCHITECTURE.md frontmatter field `last_updated: 2026-05-26` is 39 days behind the footer `Last updated: 2026-07-04`. The 2026-07-04 nightly audit fixed multiple ARCHITECTURE.md items (invariant wording, cross-cutting table, ADR citations) and updated the footer, but did not sync the frontmatter. Tools that parse frontmatter for last-update date will report a stale timestamp, potentially causing the DECISIONS.md generator (when wired) to order this file incorrectly.
findings.fix_sketch: Update frontmatter to `last_updated: 2026-07-12`. Also refresh footer Last updated and Last verified to 2026-07-12.

findings.title: .audits/index.json open_findings contains 8 findings already fixed by 2026-07-08 audit commit
findings.detail: The 2026-07-08 audit commit (801e35a) closed 10 findings but the index.json open_findings list still contains AUDIT-factory-7e8c1eea, -9e2e2cb7, -60e00c09, -b196aaab, -56a7982f, -5a72c4fb, -5b026618, and -b9a43e43 as 'open'. All eight were verified fixed by reading the current file content. The index.json fixed_count (27) also undercounts by 3 vs the 30 entries in fixed_findings. A stale index causes any automated tool or future auditor to re-open and attempt to re-fix already-closed issues.
findings.fix_sketch: Move those 8 finding IDs from open_findings to fixed_findings in index.json. Update open_count and fixed_count accordingly. Sync last_updated.

findings.title: SECURITY.md Protected Paths canonical list is missing **/(auth)/** glob enforced in CODEOWNERS and workflow
findings.detail: The **/(auth)/** glob (Next.js route-group auth pattern) is enforced in .github/CODEOWNERS and .github/workflows/protected-paths.yml but absent from SECURITY.md's canonical Protected Paths list.
